pages.title: Chronosteel Hazard Panel
pages.text: A chronosteel panel painted with warning stripes, used to mark doorways, machine edges and anything I do not want to walk into. The stripes look very slightly out of step with each other. Yellow and black on dull metal - a language every lab in every universe seems to share.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)After walking into a running time field once, I started marking hazards. Chronosteel panels with stripes were the clearest way to say keep out.
